name: Obelisco de Buenos Aires
description: A white obelisk marks the intersection of 9 de Julio and Corrientes.

name: Casa Rosada
description: Argentina’s pink presidential palace faces Plaza de Mayo.

name: Teatro Colón
description: A renowned opera house with guided tours of its gilded halls.

name: Iguazú Falls (Argentina side)
description: Walkways lead to the Devil’s Throat on the Argentine side of the falls.

name: Córdoba Cathedral
description: A colonial cathedral anchors Córdoba’s historic centre.

name: Perito Moreno Glacier
description: A advancing glacier calves ice into Lago Argentino with balcony viewpoints.

name: Ushuaia waterfront
description: A southern city on the Beagle Channel, gateway to Tierra del Fuego.

name: Mendoza Andean foothills
description: Wine valleys sit beneath Andean peaks west of Mendoza city.

name: Salta historic centre
description: Colonial plazas and a cable car to San Bernardo hill.

name: Península Valdés
description: A wildlife peninsula known for whales, penguins and sea lions.

name: Mercado de San Telmo
description: An iron market hall with antiques upstairs and food stalls below.

name: Recoleta café streets
description: Cafés and parrillas surround Recoleta’s leafy avenues.

name: Mendoza bodega tastings
description: Malbec tastings fill bodegas across Luján de Cuyo and Maipú.

name: Rosario riverfront kitchens
description: Paraná riverfront restaurants and cafés in Argentina’s third city.

name: Güemes neighbourhood eateries
description: Boutique cafés and bars in Córdoba’s Güemes area.

name: Buenos Aires Tango Festival
description: City-backed tango championships, milongas and shows — often in August.
